result.instructions: Tools for Channel Talk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customer chats are still open in our channel?"; "Show me the messages in the chat with the customer who asked about billing."; "Assign this chat to the support manager and reply that we are looking into it.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Channel Talk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run channeltalk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run channeltalk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run channeltalk_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. channeltalk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: channeltalk_get_channel
tools.title: Get the channel
tools.description: Get the Channel Talk channel this key belongs to (name, id, plan details). Good first call to check the connection. Channel Talk API: GET /open/channel.

tools.name: channeltalk_list_user_chats
tools.title: List user chats
tools.description: List customer chats (user chats), optionally filtered by state (opened, closed, snoozed, queued, initial, missed) and by a time range. Channel Talk API: GET /open/user-chats.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page (nextCursor), for paging.

limit.description: Items to return (Channel Talk default applies).

from.description: Start of the time range, Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Send with `to`.

to.description: End of the time range (exclusive), Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Send with `from`.

dateTimeFieldName.description: Field used for the time range. Defaults to deskUpdatedAt.

tools.name: channeltalk_get_user_chat
tools.title: Get a user chat
tools.description: Get one customer chat by id. Optionally include the read bookmark or the participant sessions. Channel Talk API: GET /open/user-chats/{userChatId}.

tools.name: channeltalk_list_user_chat_messages
tools.title: List messages in a user chat
tools.description: List the messages of one customer chat, with paging by cursor or by a time range. Channel Talk API: GET /open/user-chats/{userChatId}/messages.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page (nextCursor), for paging.

limit.description: Items to return (Channel Talk default applies).

from.description: Start of the time range, Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Send with `to`.

to.description: End of the time range (exclusive), Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Send with `from`.

annotations.title: List messages in a user chat

tools.name: channeltalk_get_message_file_url
tools.title: Get a message file download URL
tools.description: Get a download URL for a file attached to a message in a user chat. Pass the file key from the message. Channel Talk API: GET /open/user-chats/{userChatId}/messages/file.

key.description: File key from the message's file entry.

annotations.title: Get a message file download URL

tools.name: channeltalk_list_managers
tools.title: List managers
tools.description: List the managers (operators, agents) of the channel. Use the manager id to assign chats. Channel Talk API: GET /open/managers.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page (nextCursor), for paging.

limit.description: Items to return (Channel Talk default applies).

tools.name: channeltalk_get_manager
tools.title: Get a manager
tools.description: Get one manager by id. Channel Talk API: GET /open/managers/{managerId}.

tools.name: channeltalk_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the groups (team inboxes) of the channel. Channel Talk API: GET /open/groups.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page (nextCursor), for paging.

limit.description: Items to return (Channel Talk default applies).

tools.name: channeltalk_get_group
tools.title: Get a group
tools.description: Get one group by id. Channel Talk API: GET /open/groups/{groupId}.

tools.name: channeltalk_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one customer (user) by user id. Channel Talk API: GET /open/users/{userId}.

tools.name: channeltalk_get_user_by_member_id
tools.title: Get a user by member id
tools.description: Get one customer by your own member id (the id you use in your system, set when the user was created). Channel Talk API: GET /open/users/@{memberId}.

memberId.description: Your member id for the customer.

annotations.title: Get a user by member id

tools.name: channeltalk_list_chat_tags
tools.title: List chat tags
tools.description: List the chat tags defined for the channel. Channel Talk API: GET /open/chat-tags.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page (nextCursor), for paging.

limit.description: Items to return (Channel Talk default applies).

tools.name: channeltalk_send_message
tools.title: Send a message in a user chat
tools.description: Send a plain-text message to the customer in one chat. The customer sees it at once; this cannot be undone. Use only when the user asked for this reply. Channel Talk API: POST /open/user-chats/{userChatId}/messages.

botName.description: Bot name shown as the sender of this action in Channel Talk.

annotations.title: Send a message in a user chat

tools.name: channeltalk_assign_user_chat
tools.title: Assign a user chat to a manager
tools.description: Assign one customer chat to a manager. Repeating the same assignment has no further effect. Channel Talk API: PATCH /open/user-chats/{userChatId}/assign-to/managers/{managerId}.

botName.description: Bot name shown as the sender of this action in Channel Talk.

annotations.title: Assign a user chat to a manager

tools.name: channeltalk_unassign_user_chat
tools.title: Unassign a user chat
tools.description: Remove the manager from one customer chat. Repeating the call has no further effect. Channel Talk API: PATCH /open/user-chats/{userChatId}/unassign.

botName.description: Bot name shown as the sender of this action in Channel Talk.

tools.name: channeltalk_close_user_chat
tools.title: Close a user chat
tools.description: Close one customer chat. Closing a chat that is already closed has no further effect. Channel Talk API: PATCH /open/user-chats/{userChatId}/close.

botName.description: Bot name shown as the sender of this action in Channel Talk.
